title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-07-20
content:
Weekly update: Private Deployments (Wk of 2026-07-20)

Owners and contributors
- Owner: Nadia Chen (eng-private-deployments)
- Contributors: Marcus Lee, Priya Raman, Elena Torres, Jordan Park

High-level summary
- Focus this week: three active on-prem/VPC installs (ACME, Finova, HealthSync), unblock KMS/HSM integrations for air-gapped installs, and stabilize agent telemetry for kernel variations.
- Major blocker: ACME VPC peering + customer firewall rules preventing control-plane connectivity; blocks progress on cert rotation and agent enrollment.
- Progress: Finova completed preflight checks and started data plane tests; HealthSync staging deploy passed E2E smoke tests after a kernel workaround.

Customer-specific updates
1) ACME Corp (on-prem + VPC peering)
- Status: blocked
- Details: Customer reported asymmetric routing in their edge firewall causing control-plane heartbeats to drop. Our agent enroll attempts (PD-789) show TLS handshake failures from customer side after DTLS fallback.
- Troubleshooting done: Marcus ran packet captures with customer, identified NAT translation on port range 1024-65535 caused by legacy firewall rule; proposed changes to use single allowed port 8443 for control-plane.
- Next steps: Customer to open change window this Friday 7/24. Priya will provide updated runbook snippet and temporary ingress rule for 8443. Action owners: Priya (runbook), ACME network team (change window).
- Risks: If customer refuses firewall change, we will have to ship a tunneled proxy option (longer ETA ~2 weeks).

2) Finova (private deployment, KMS integration)
- Status: progressing
- Details: Customer key ops completed key provisioning in AWS KMS but HSM-backed keys require policy adjustments. Our KMS auth plugin failed to fetch key metadata (PD-812) due to IAM role missing kms:DescribeKey.
- Troubleshooting: Elena coordinated with Finova SecOps; role updated and plugin re-tested in staging.
- Next steps: schedule final key rotation test Monday 7/27. Jordan to run rotation scenario and confirm audit events are emitted.

3) HealthSync (air-gapped on-prem)
- Status: success (staging)
- Details: Install initially failed on RHEL8 systems with older libseccomp; agent sandbox crashed during sandbox init. Workaround: fallback to userspace seccomp shim included in airgap bundle 0.9.3.
- Next steps: update airgap packaging docs and add libseccomp check to preflight script.

Incidents & Blockers
- Blocker: ACME VPC peering / firewall (see above). Impact: blocks cert rotation and onboarding (~3-5 business days delay).
- Blocker: Telemetry batching regression observed after agent 1.12.0 -> 1.13.0 deploy (internal). Several customers reported missing token-level cost telemetry for short-lived sessions. Root cause: batching timeout default changed from 200ms to 2s, causing some short sessions to not flush before process exit.
- Mitigation: Rollback to 1.12.2 for affected customer installs (done for 2 customers). Patch: 1.13.1 will default to 200ms and expose config flag. ETA: hotfix release 7/22.

Weekly standup highlights (daily snippets)
- Mon 7/20: ACME packet captures + runbook updates. Finova key role update. HealthSync packaging triage.
- Tue 7/21: Telemetry rollback executed for two customers; hotfix branch created. Begin preparing tunneled proxy design (low-priority fallback).
- Wed 7/22: Security review for KMS policy template. Agent 1.13.1 Q/A started.
- Thu 7/23: Customer change windows confirmed for ACME. Runbook diff published.
- Fri 7/24: Reserved for ACME firewall change; on-call standby.

Action items (owners & ETA)
- Priya Raman: Publish ACME firewall runbook snippet and single-port 8443 guidance (ETA: 2026-07-22).
- Marcus Lee: Coordinate with ACME on packet capture follow-ups and verify control-plane handshakes after change window (ETA: 2026-07-24).
- Jordan Park: Run key rotation test for Finova and produce audit verification report (ETA: 2026-07-27).
- Elena Torres: Update airgap bundle docs and add libseccomp preflight check (ETA: 2026-07-23).
- Nadia Chen: Draft tunneled proxy design doc as fallback option if customers cannot change firewall (ETA: 2026-08-03).
- Release Engineering: Cut 1.13.1 hotfix with telemetry timeout revert (PR created; ETA release 2026-07-22). Linked artifact: JIRA PD-820.

Notes & follow-ups
- Need to prioritize a short-term feature flag to control telemetry flush timeout per install; this will reduce customer blast radius for future changes.
- Ask SRE to add synthetic heartbeat checks for newly onboarded on-prem installs to detect asymmetric routing quickly.
- Consider adding a single-port control-plane mode to our runbook as a supported pattern for restrictive firewall customers (low-effort, high-value).

Attached artifacts / references
- Confluence: ACME on-prem runbook (link in metadata)
- Jira: PD-789 (ACME network), PD-812 (Finova KMS), PD-820 (telemetry hotfix)
- Slack: private-deployments channel thread TS-456 for ACME packet captures

Overall health & ask
- Team capacity: medium; two engineers on-call for ACME weekend window.
- Asks: Customer Success to nudge ACME network to approve the 8443 change window; Security to fast-track KMS policy review if Finova rotation test shows gaps.

End of weekly update.
